comment: Exemptions and platform metadata for verify.sh. crossBuildExemptions lists packages that may not cross-compile for a target (e.g. cgo); each entry must reference a real package and is verified by verify_test.go. platformsNotGated lists GOOS values that appear in build tags of repository sources but are intentionally not part of the offline cross-build gate.

platformsNotGated.reason: shares the kqueue/bsd sources with the gated darwin and freebsd targets; not part of the offline gate
